name: What factors determine the cost of baseboard installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of baseboard installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboard installation costs depend on linear footage, the height and profile of the molding, and whether the trim requires priming, caulking, and painting. Simple, pre-primed finger-jointed pine or MDF in standard sizes is the most economical. Taller profiles, custom profiles, or stain-grade hardwoods increase material costs. The overall price is also shaped by job site conditions, such as wavy drywall, out-of-square corners, or transitioning between existing carpet and new tile, all of which require extra scribe cuts and prep work by the trim carpenter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total linear footage, baseboard height, material choice (MDF vs. wood), and wall prep needs like repairing uneven drywall or complex corners.
